champions.name: Kael
champions.role_notes: Best used as a consistent damage carry, especially when he can clear multiple enemies efficiently. Prioritize scaling and consistency over pure utility.
champions.progression_path: Early to mid game: focus on basic damage scaling, Accuracy, and Speed. Late game: improve crit and sustain depending on team needs.

champions.name: Elhain
champions.role_notes: Useful for speed and team support while still contributing damage. Build for synergy if she is used as a utility nuker or speed support.
champions.progression_path: Prioritize Speed and Accuracy early. Add damage scaling after core utility is established.

champions.name: Galek
champions.role_notes: Strong burst-focused attacker; works well when the build emphasizes consistent turns and damage output.
champions.progression_path: Early progression should focus on Speed and Attack. Later adjustments depend on whether he is used as a finisher or a more general damage carry.

champions.name: Astar
champions.role_notes: If used for utility and control, prioritize Speed and Accuracy before raw damage. Sustain and team setup matter more than burst.
champions.progression_path: Build for consistent turn order and utility first, then add survivability and team support.

champions.name: Myrmid
champions.role_notes: Tanks should favor survivability and battlefield control. Attack should be a secondary concern unless the champion has a strong offense role.
champions.progression_path: Prioritize durability and proper turn order. Upgrade offense later only if the champion is expected to contribute meaningful damage.

champions.name: Frosty
champions.role_notes: Control champions need to act early and land important debuffs. A stable speed and accuracy build is more valuable than raw offense.
champions.progression_path: Focus on preventing enemies from acting rather than maximizing DPS. Build for team utility first.

champions.name: Sicia
champions.role_notes: Hybrid champions need a balanced build. Prioritize whichever stat helps them maintain both function and output in their team role.
champions.progression_path: Build a hybrid route where utility wins early, then add offense once the champion can safely fulfill their core role.

champions.name: Warlord
champions.role_notes: Bruiser champions usually need durability and output. The best build is one that preserves offensive pressure without losing survivability.
champions.progression_path: Upgrade survivability first, then increase attack and critical output to convert that durability into stronger offense.
